<?php
defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Petshop_Import_Rules v1.2
 */
class Petshop_Import_Rules {

    private array $excluded_brands = [
        'hau&miau', 'hau & miau', 'bioveterinary', 'biovet',
    ];

    private array $excluded_in_title = [
        'hau&miau', 'hau & miau', 'bioveterinary',
    ];

    /**
     * Brand map — pagrindiniams ZB brandams.
     * contains logika (fix #4 v1.2).
     */
    private array $brand_map = [
        'monge'       => 'Monge',
        'eukanuba'    => 'Eukanuba',
        'trixie'      => 'Trixie',
        'gimcat'      => 'GimCat',
        'gimdog'      => 'GimDog',
        'gimborn'     => 'Gimborn',
        'gimbi'       => 'GimBi',
        'family dog'  => 'Family Dog',
        'family cat'  => 'Family Cat',
        'pess'        => 'Pess',
        "biokat's"    => "Biokat's",
        'biokats'     => "Biokat's",
        'biokat'      => "Biokat's",
        "hill's"      => "Hill's",
        'hills'       => "Hill's",
        'royal canin' => 'Royal Canin',
        'brit'        => 'Brit',
        'josera'      => 'Josera',
        'ontario'     => 'Ontario',
        'carnilove'   => 'Carnilove',
        'profine'     => 'Profine',
        'gemon'       => 'Gemon',
        'oasy'        => 'Oasy',
        'acana'       => 'Acana',
        'orijen'      => 'Orijen',
        'vitapol'     => 'Vitapol',
        'animonda'    => 'Animonda',
        'miamor'      => 'Miamor',
        'duvo'        => 'Duvo+',
    ];

    public function is_excluded_brand( string $brand_or_title ): bool {
        $lower = strtolower( trim( $brand_or_title ) );
        foreach ( $this->excluded_brands as $e ) {
            if ( $lower === $e ) return true;
        }
        foreach ( $this->excluded_in_title as $e ) {
            if ( str_contains( $lower, $e ) ) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Normalizuoja brendą.
     * Pirma — tiesioginis atitikimas.
     * Tada — contains pavadinime pagrindiniams brandams (fix #4 v1.2).
     */
    public function normalize_brand( string $brand, string $clean_title = '' ): string {
        $b = strtolower( trim( $brand ) );

        // Tiesioginis atitikimas
        if ( isset( $this->brand_map[ $b ] ) ) {
            return $this->brand_map[ $b ];
        }

        // Contains — iš pavadinimo
        $search = $clean_title ?: $brand;
        $lower  = strtolower( $search );
        foreach ( $this->brand_map as $key => $value ) {
            if ( str_contains( $lower, $key ) ) {
                return $value;
            }
        }

        return $brand ? ucfirst( trim( $brand ) ) : '';
    }

    /**
     * Nustato statusą ir pildo $review_reasons per reference.
     */
    public function determine_status(
        int    $post_id,
        string $ean,
        float  $cost,
        int    $qty,
        array  $cat_slugs,
        array  &$review_reasons = []
    ): string {

        if ( empty( $ean ) )       $review_reasons[] = 'missing_ean';
        if ( $cost <= 0 )          $review_reasons[] = 'missing_cost';
        if ( $qty <= 0 )           $review_reasons[] = 'qty_zero';
        if ( empty( $cat_slugs ) ) $review_reasons[] = 'missing_category';

        $has_thumb = has_post_thumbnail( $post_id );
        $gallery   = get_post_meta( $post_id, '_product_image_gallery', true );
        if ( ! $has_thumb && empty( $gallery ) ) {
            $review_reasons[] = 'missing_image';
        }

        $post = get_post( $post_id );
        if ( $post && empty( trim( wp_strip_all_tags( $post->post_content ) ) ) ) {
            $review_reasons[] = 'missing_description';
        }

        return empty( $review_reasons ) ? 'publish' : 'draft';
    }

    public function strip_inline_styles( string $content ): string {
        if ( empty( $content ) ) return $content;
        $content = preg_replace( '/\s+style=["\'][^"\']*["\']/', '', $content );
        $content = preg_replace( '/\s+width=["\'][^"\']*["\']/', '', $content );
        return $content;
    }

    public function clean_title( string $title ): string {
        $cleaned = preg_replace( '/^[A-Z]{0,2}\d{4,6}\s+(?:[A-Z]{2}\s+)?/', '', trim( $title ) );
        return trim( $cleaned ) ?: trim( $title );
    }

    public function is_oversize( float $w, float $l, float $wi, float $h ): bool {
        return $w > 10 || $l > 60 || $wi > 40 || $h > 40;
    }
}
